## Method and independence

This seat is the closing checker, independent of the author. The lane log held no line for `check/M0-e-05-close-s1`,
so the seat started fresh. Machine id: `linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor:4cpu:16gib`. Node: v24.12.0. W = 1 throughout,
from `tools/test_budget.py` (1, and `--mutants` 1).

The brief requires reading each source note whole, and all of them are in `checks/M0-e-05-notes.md`. So this seat read
that file whole, including the builder's 'Hardening round S1' section that follows the source notes. That reading
happened before the probes were planned. This seat used that section as no evidence: every result below was re-run
first-hand.

The mirror is `/home/user/maps-scratch/waves/check-M0-e-05/close-s1/plat`, a `cp -a` copy of `plat/`. It is isolated:
`find -lname '/home/user/maps-architecture*'` printed nothing, and the realpaths of `layout/node_modules/@plat/site`
and `@plat/kernel` lie inside the mirror. All 18 `src/fields` and `test/fields` hashes equal `landed/M0-e-05.json`.
For each mutant, the script `tools/mut.py` applies one exact-once replacement and runs `vitest run --maxWorkers=1
test/fields/ --reporter=json` without `--bail`, so every red test is listed. It then restores the file by copy and
checks it with `cmp`.
